Who we are?

Serving the Guests of Allah

Established in 2003 with a vision to provide and serve the guest of Allah. The full satisfaction and trustworthy keep us stand for 20 years in Hajj & Umrah field.

Dream Zone is the company specialized in the hospitality and residential sectors in Saudi Arabia Mecca. Stretching for over decades, we manage, develop, operate hotels and residential communities across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Our Company DreamZone Hotel Operation in collaboration with Samaya Transport, Bena Umrah Service and Arafa group of Hajj and Service work together to group the business in Hajj & Umrah.
